summary: Provide a single-use bounded scratch applicability check for the opt-in agent collection source.

replay.detail: The runner uses the existing explicit source constructor and bounded Installer lifecycle only on a scratch backup; it introduces no replay or eligibility mechanism.

schema.detail: Cardinality gauges use TEMP schema in the isolated child only; production schema, source descriptors, fingerprints and limits are unchanged.

rules.detail: No admission, checkpoint, authority or readiness rule changes.

compatibility.detail: A standalone example and Python supervisor add metadata inspection without changing socket frames, client code or daemon routes.

downtime.detail: The vehicle runs on an existing consistent scratch backup, starts no daemon or harness and never opens the live database. Populated-host execution and macOS resource fit remain unqualified.

manual.detail: Ops can run one marked scratch qualification with exact binary/source pins, original receiver and online-backup provenance, subject to 900 seconds and explicit resource bounds. Success is scratch applicability only; activation and profiles remain separately gated.

recovery.detail: Refusal and timeout keep live opt-in disabled. The supervisor terminates its own child and retains private bounded diagnostics; Ops removes only its owned marked scratch after recording evidence. No production restore, trigger uninstall or cap increase is introduced.
